purpose: Validate adoption of mandatory stage re-entry, attempt convergence, strict DONE semantics, evidence-backed terminal closure, and successor/decomposition governance.
locked_principles: Failure count, elapsed time, fatigue, or opinion are never closure criteria.
Every attempt closes with evidence even when the stage remains active.
Rerun requires reading current prior-attempt lineage before code changes.
Improving diagnostic convergence keeps a stage active while a reasonable remediation remains.
WAITING_VERIFIED_DEPENDENCY is active and requires evidence plus an objective resume trigger.
DONE means the declared stage objective and exit criteria were achieved.
An evaluation stage may be DONE with a valid FAIL verdict when producing the verdict is the stage objective.
Terminal unresolved closure requires objective evidence and a reviewed decision.
Successor/decomposition must be materially different and map all residual objectives.
